description:
Auto-clicker and macro recorder - record clicks, keys, delays and moves, then replay them on a global hotkey.

Autrix is a clean, capable automation tool for Windows. Record mouse clicks, key presses, delays, text input, mouse moves, and timed hold actions — then replay them on a hotkey from any window. The recorder now captures input exactly: button and key holds, click-and-drags, and keys held down across other actions are all reproduced with millisecond timing — set it up right and it can run a full game parkour sequence on its own. Save multiple profiles, edit actions inline, tune recording precision per-session, customize the always-on-top status popup, and push click rates past 1000 CPS.

Free for personal use; business or commercial use requires a paid license.

- Same font and text sizes as the other TAPATCH apps, so most text is a little bigger
- New UI size in Settings → Size and window: text, buttons and panels get bigger or smaller together (60–200%). Ctrl + and Ctrl − work too, Ctrl 0 goes back to 100%
- The window opens where you left it, on the same screen and at the same size. Or pick Full screen under When the window opens
license_or_tos: Free for personal use; commercial use requires a paid license
